audit_target: Nomad Analyst — Phase 2.2 Historical Options Coverage Audit
attribution: Data sourced from thetrademarkk/india-index-options-1m on Hugging Face (CC BY-NC 4.0). Personal research and paper trading only. No commercial use.
spot_reference_convention: Opening price of the 09:15:00 IST bar from index/NIFTY.parquet
atm_strike_convention: round(spot_reference_price / 50.0) * 50 based on verified ₹50 historical strike interval
bid_ask_disclaimer: Historical bid/ask order book quotes are UNAVAILABLE in the 1-minute OHLCV dataset and have NOT been fabricated.

classification_criteria.COMPLETE_FOR_DEFINED_SCOPE: Trading day has both CE and PE for ATM and key nearby strikes (ATM +/- 50, 100), with continuous market coverage >= 360 minutes (09:15-15:30 IST).
classification_criteria.PARTIAL: Options data exists for the trading day, but exhibits either incomplete nearby strike pairs or shortened/incomplete intraday minutes (< 360 mins).
classification_criteria.MISSING: Zero option records found for the index trading day in the source dataset.
classification_criteria.NOT_TESTED: Trading days outside the requested 2025-07-01 to 2026-07-02 historical window.
